---
title: Core
---

## Functions

- [`aes`](aes.qmd) - Bind column names to visual channels to form an aesthetic mapping.
- [`as-factor`](as-factor.qmd) - Coerce a column to string factors, or tag an aesthetic as discrete.
- [`as-numeric`](as-numeric.qmd) - Coerce a column to numeric, or tag an aesthetic as continuous.
- [`plot`](plot.qmd) - Compose a layered plot from data, aesthetics, and geom layers.
